name: Missed-call rescue
tagline: A missed call becomes a booking instead of a lost job

roadmap.note: The software is built and proven end to end - answer, text back, voicemail transcribed, job details extracted, booking conversion tracked. Numbers are being issued as telephony access is enabled per country; the live conversational agent stays deferred behind the evidence in the voice analysis.

marketing.summary: When a call goes unanswered, the caller gets a text within seconds with a link to book themselves in, and you get the lead in your inbox. Most people who reach voicemail simply ring the next name on the list; this catches them before they do.
marketing.audience: Anyone whose hands are busy during the hours customers ring, and for whom a missed call is a lost job.

features.title: Faster than any voicemail
features.body: The text goes out while they are still holding the phone. Speed is the whole mechanism - it is what makes a caller stop looking.

features.title: They book themselves in
features.body: The link goes to your real availability, so the job lands in your diary without either of you making a call.

features.title: Nothing to answer, nothing to go wrong
features.body: No robot voice, no misheard address, no price quoted that you would not honour. Your customers speak to you, or they book.

features.title: You find out whether it worked
features.body: Every rescued call is tracked through to whether it became a booking. Nobody in this category publishes that number, so most businesses are guessing about whether any of it pays.

faq.q: Why not an AI that answers the phone?
faq.a: We looked at it seriously and decided against it for now. Every AI phone agent on the market answers about a second and a half late, which callers hear as a dropped line, and around a third of people say they would hang up on one. If it handles a call badly, your customer blames you, not us. A text that arrives in two seconds does most of the same job with none of that risk.
No. It reacts to a missed call; there is nothing to record and nothing to transcribe.
